content.stem: 埃格蒙特集团的一项基本原则是：

options.A: 发布有关报告可疑情况的标准
options.B: 促进监管机构的组织工作
options.C: 发布关于国际调查所作决定的信息
options.D: 建立金融情报机构（FIU）之间的信息共享机制

content.stem_en: A basic principle of the Egmont Group is to:

options_en.A: Publish standards for reporting suspicious matters
options_en.B: Facilitate the organization of regulatory authorities
options_en.C: Publish decisions taken on international investigations
options_en.D: Arrange information-sharing protocols between Financial Intelligence Units (FIUs)
